senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כור, cmp. כְּבָרָה a. כְּוֶורֶת)smelting pot, smelting furnace.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 6:16">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:9">Kel. VIII, 9</cite> <he>כ׳ … של עושה זכיכית</he> (Var. <he>בור</he>) the glassmaker’s pot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:4">Sabb. VIII, 4</cite> <he>כ׳ של צורפי זהב</he> the gold refiners’ pot.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 114:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIV</cite> <he>כאדם … מתוך הכ׳ וכ׳</he> like a man that takes gold out of the smelting pot without tongs &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite> <he>כ׳ של אש</he> a burning furnace; a. e.
